column1: # Nine Commits, post 3 — what each run actually read.
# Derived from the 21 traces of rows 22-42 in runs.tsv, one row each, by
# walking every search_files result in the trace. Those 21 raw traces are not
# committed: each one embeds a listing of this whole repository and they come
# to about a megabyte, and a trace inside a published post directory that the
# leak gate is not scanning is worse than no trace. The one run that IS
# committed in full is trace.json, and its row is the shape of these.
# post_files_matched  every file under site/src/content/posts/ that appeared in
#                     that run's search results — the published posts 1 and 2.
# saw_post2_answer_line  the run's results included 02-hands/index.mdx line 102,
#                     which states both graded facts in one sentence.
# saw_cli_usage_line  the run's results included agent/src/cli.ts line 48, the
#                     agent's own usage message, which also states both facts.
# saw_config_ts_line  the run's results included agent/src/config.ts line 1,
# answer_names_a_post  whether the run's final answer referred to a post, a
#                     README, a .mdx file or DECISIONS.md rather than the source.
